paper_title: NExtLong Toward Effective Long-Context Training without Long Documents
caption: NExtLong reduces the model's dependence on proximal text. We calculated the degree of dependence on proximal text (the last third of the text) for different methods when completing the LongQA task. It can be observed that NExtLong significantly reduces the model's dependence on proximal text.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the short-dependence attention weight for different methods. The horizontal axis represents the methods, which are listed in no particular order, and the vertical axis represents the attention weight, with a range of 0.80 to 0.90 and a linear scale. The chart features five blue bars, each representing a method: Standard, ICLM, KNN, Quest, and NExtLong. The Standard method has an attention weight of approximately 0.87, while the ICLM method has a weight of around 0.85, and the KNN and Quest methods both have weights of about 0.86. The NExtLong method has the lowest attention weight, at approximately 0.82. There is no specific sorting or visual emphasis applied to the bars, and no additional grouping or stacking of bars is present.
